entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: One of the seven continents of Zendikar, a humid region of lagoons and swamps and homeland of Zendikar's vampires.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A continent separated from Guul Draz by a giant marsh; its destruction was shared by Guul Draz's north.

entities.name: Guul Draz Skyclave
entities.description: A floating ruined fortress once destroyed by the Roil and now risen from the swamps.

entities.name: Lulea
entities.description: A merfolk settlement on Lake Jeft led by Ennesh.

entities.name: Ennesh
entities.description: The stern sage who leads the merfolk of Lulea.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: Former vampire capital, now a guarded fortress led by Drana of the Kalastria clan.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: Leader of the fortress of Malakir from the Kalastria clan.

entities.name: Nimana
entities.description: A human coastal city that is a trade port for slavers.

entities.name: Hagra Cistern
entities.description: An ancient merfolk-built structure meant to cleanse Eldrazi corruption, whose magic failed.

entities.name: Lake of Dust
entities.description: The desolate northernmost swampland of Guul Draz, a barren scar sharing Bala Ged's destruction.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings against whom the Hagra Cistern was built and to whom the Forsaken Monument is dedicated.

entities.name: Eternal Pilgrims
entities.description: A group likely to have raised the Forsaken Monument.

events.summary: The northernmost part of Guul Draz shares in Bala Ged's utter destruction and becomes the Lake of Dust.
events.quote: shared in that region’s utter destruction

events.summary: The Hagra Cistern's magic fails over time, turning the area into a festering mire haunted by ogres and demons.
events.quote: Its magic failed over time, turning the area into a festering mire
